crossRefs.note: For God will bring every work into judgment, with every hidden thing, whether it is good, or whether it is evil.
in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.
You fathers, don’t provoke your children to wrath, but nurture them in the discipline and instruction of the Lord.
About these also Enoch, the seventh from Adam, prophesied, saying, “Behold, the Lord came with ten thousands of his…
to execute judgment on all, and to convict all the ungodly of all their works of ungodliness which they have done in an…
I saw the dead, the great and the small, standing before the throne, and they opened books. Another book was opened…

translations.web: I tell you that every idle word that men speak, they will give account of it in the day of judgment.
translations.bsb: But I tell you that men will give an account on the day of judgment for every careless word they have spoken.
translations.kjv: But I say unto you, That every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
translations.asv: And I say unto you, that every idle word that men shall speak, they shall give account thereof in the day of judgment.
